title: CITERIFT shared contract definitions, major version 1
description: Identifiers, provenance and the epistemic assertion wrapper shared by all CITERIFT records. Formats whose real-world shape has not yet been verified (Stages 02 and 03) are kept deliberately permissive.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the contract the record was written against. Minor versions within major 1 are backward compatible.

utc_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp, ISO 8601 with a trailing Z. The pattern fixes the shape in every engine; the 'date-time' format rejects impossible calendar values such as 2026-02-31 (CITERIFT validators always enable this format check, without optional libraries).

doi.description: A DOI as cited. Normalization rules are a Stage 02 deliverable; this pattern only rejects strings that cannot be a DOI. The registrant code may be subdivided (10.1000.10/..., DOI Handbook 2.2.2).

wiki_language.description: Wikipedia language edition code (subdomain), e.g. 'en', 'ar', 'simple', 'zh-yue'. The supported set is decided in Stage 03 from feasibility evidence.

source_ref.description: Where a piece of evidence came from and when it was retrieved.

source_id.description: Stable short name of the source, e.g. 'retraction-watch', 'wikimedia-api'.

source_version.description: Dataset snapshot, API version or revision id.

epistemic_status.description: verified_fact: established from cited sources. model_inference: produced by a model, never a fact. uncertain: evidence is insufficient. unavailable: the information could not be obtained. conflicting: sources disagree.

assertion.description: A value together with what is known about how true it is. Every factual field in CITERIFT records uses this wrapper.

confidence.description: Model-reported score in [0, 1]. It is not a probability of correctness unless a later stage calibrates and documents it.
